title: A successful worktree merge reports verdict blocked when the default branch is held elsewhere
description: housekeeping demotes default_branch_held_elsewhere to advisory, but the three status expectation checks it delegates to stay blocking, so a clean merge exits 1. A fourth check separately misreports the merged branch as unmerged; that one is advisory and does not affect the exit status
